proof.text: For canonical left derived pullback the oplax tensorator is leftDerivedUpperStarTensorIso.hom. The monoidal inverse identity therefore identifies its lax tensorator with leftDerivedUpperStarTensorIso.inv. Transport the monoidal structure through leftDerivedUpperStarIsoMapDerivedCategory. The formula for transport of the lax tensorator is exactly the composite defining etaleSumExtensionTensorPullbackIso, by the two whiskering formulas for derivedTensor.

Apply the existing source-library derived projection formula [lem-pur-source-etale-derived-projection] to coefficient category ModuleCat A. Projection invertibility is equivalent to invertibility of the internal-hom comparison of the monoidal right adjoint. Monoidal transport preserves that comparison, hence the projection for the exact termwise derived adjunction is invertible too, regardless of the choice of the adjunction on these fixed functors. Its component equals the specified adjoint transpose etaleSumExtensionTensorComparison.

Expand the transpose as sum extension of tensor of the unit followed by the tensorator, then counit. Counit naturality moves tensor of the counit inside sum extension. Tensorator naturality and the right triangle identity cancel unit followed by pulled-back counit, leaving sum extension of the tensorator followed by counit at the tensor product. This proves the exact displayed fold-counit equation for arbitrary unbounded objects. The Lean calculation is performed over an abstract coefficient category before specializing to ModuleCat A, avoiding expansion of concrete derived functor data.

title: Tensor compatibility for etale sum extension
statement:
Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring and let $v:V\to T$ be a separated etale morphism of finite type between Noetherian schemes (schemes admitting finite affine covers by spectra of Noetherian rings). On the entire ordinary etale derived categories of constant-$A$ module sheaves, for $B\in D(T_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ and $M\in D(V_{\mathrm{et}},A)$, the canonical map induced by the termwise sum-extension construction
$$v_!(v^*B\otimes_A^L M)\longrightarrow B\otimes_A^L v_!M$$
is an isomorphism. Write $P_{B,M}$ for this comparison and $\epsilon_C:v_!v^*C\to C$ for the fold counit of $v_!\dashv v^*$ [lem-amb-etale-adjoint-locality]. For every $C\in D(T_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ its counit compatibility is the identity
$$(1_B\otimes\epsilon_C)\circ P_{B,v^*C}=\epsilon_{B\otimes_A^LC}\circ v_!(\theta_{B,C}),$$
where $\theta_{B,C}:v^*B\otimes_A^Lv^*C\xrightarrow{\sim}v^*(B\otimes_A^LC)$ is the canonical tensor-pullback comparison. The assertion and this equality hold for arbitrary unbounded $B,M,C$. The notation and functors used here are the ones in [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories] [def-weil-pbc-etale-sum-extension] [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] [def-kun-derived-tensor] [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback] [prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact]. The scheme, Noetherian, etale, separated and finite-type notions are as in [def-pc-scheme] [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] [def-weil-etale-morphism] [def-weil-proper-morphism] [def-weil-finite-type-morphism].
